regime_context: The detector is in a 'discipline_not_prediction' regime: momentum rank is a focus lens only, the one validated edge is absolute-trend-gate drawdown/vol control (gate_helps=true), and rotation timing is display-only. AI Infrastructure leads on rank but with mixed hurst and low breadth (0.125), while Energy Complex ranks #2 with stronger durability (0.62) and much better breadth (0.636); rotation margin is narrow (0.185) and flagged non-directional/narrowing, so this is a leadership cluster, not a one-narrative market.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Managed Care & Insurers (durability_bar 0.81, breadth 0.778, crowded: true) trades off its extreme crowding into a confirmed retreat while Utilities EW (breadth 0.484, crowding_z -0.87, currently ineligible via the absolute-trend gate) re-establishes eligibility and positive trend-health — the condition that would retire this watch is either Managed Care's crowding_z normalizing below 0.8 while keeping its trend, or Utilities EW failing to regain eligible status within 30 trading days.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is the highest-ranked eligible theme with the best trend-quality profile of the leaders: durability_bar 0.62 (above the 0.5 bar), breadth 0.636 (broad participation, not a narrow leader), crowding_z 0.93 (below the crowded threshold), and hurst 'mixed' but eligible. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge, and Energy passes it cleanly. I am NOT citing its rank #2 as alpha — only noting it is eligible, broad, and uncrowded, which supports a low-conviction trend-continuation lean rather than a fade.
theses.dissent: Energy's hurst tag is 'mixed', not 'trend', meaning the price memory is only partially persistent; a mixed-hurst eligible theme can chop sideways and the modest rank-IC of momentum gives no forward confidence that the broad participation continues.

falsifier.text: XLE lags the S&P 500 by more than 3% before the 30-day check-by, or Energy breadth (frac of constituents above the absolute-trend bar) drops below 0.5 while still ranked top-3

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the headline leader and top rank, but it is a narrow, weakly-cohesive leader: breadth 0.125 (only ~1 in 8 constituents participating) and hurst 'mixed'. It is eligible and not crowded (crowding_z 0.15), and the absolute-trend gate permits exposure. The lean is a stay-with-the-leader trend-continuation, explicitly NOT a crowding fade and NOT a rank-based buy — the low breadth is a size-down caution, not a reason to exit.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.125 means leadership is resting on very few names; a momentum leader with thin participation and mixed trend-health is vulnerable to a single-stock shake-out, and the detector has no forward edge on whether this leadership persists.

falsifier.text: SMH breaks below its absolute-trend gate (trend discipline flips to non-eligible) while Energy Complex still holds the gate, or AI Infrastructure breadth falls toward 0.0 without recovering by the 21-day check-by

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity has the strongest trend-health tag available ('trend' hurst) and passes the absolute-trend gate, but it is the most crowded eligible theme (crowding_z 1.61, crowded: true). Crowding is not a fade/short signal — it is a size-down caution. Since I cannot size, I express this as an underweight lean relative to the cleaner Energy/Defensive trend alternatives: hold the trend but expect lower marginal upside per unit of risk given crowding.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is the highest-durability name in the top tier (0.75 bar) with genuine trending behavior and 0.6 breadth; crowding flags have no basket-level forward edge, so the underweight may simply forfeit the strongest confirmed trend.

falsifier.text: CIBR maintains its absolute-trend eligibility and relative leadership over XLV/XLU defensive alternatives through the 30-day check-by, while its crowding_z normalizes below 1.0

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
